product.name: Deliv Bike
product.description: A delivery service using bikes for fast door-to-door transport of small goods up to 20 kg and 50 cm in each dimension.

product.name: 3-Wheeler (Auto) Delivery
product.description: A delivery service using three-wheeled auto vehicles for medium-sized boxes and gift hampers up to 500 kg and 5.5 ft by 4.5 ft by 5.5 ft.

product.name: TATA-ACE (Open Bed) Delivery
product.description: A delivery service using TATA-ACE open bed vehicles for multiple medium to large items up to 750 kg and 7 ft by 4.5 ft by 6 ft.

product.name: TATA-ACE (Closed) Delivery
product.description: A delivery service using closed bed TATA-ACE vehicles for multiple medium to large items up to 750 kg and 8 ft by 4.5 ft by 5.5 ft.

product.name: TATA 407 Delivery
product.description: A delivery service using TATA 407 trucks for medium to large items up to 2500 kg and 9 ft by 5.5 ft by 6 ft.

product.name: On-Demand Delivery Platform
product.description: A mobile and web platform connecting users with local merchants and delivery providers for on-demand pickup and delivery services.
